business_problem: Cemig was looking for solutions to improve efficiency and productivity, facing challenges with manual processes.
solution_summary: Cemig built this solution on Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Microsoft Teams. Cemig was looking for solutions to improve efficiency and productivity, facing challenges with manual processes. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics to business users. Power Apps delivers low-code business applications used by employees in the new process. Power Automate runs workflow automations and approvals across connected systems. Microsoft Teams presents collaboration workflows and shared communication experiences to end users. Amid the pandemic and the shift to remote work, Cemig urgently needed to adopt technologies that would ensure the continuity of operations. Microsoft Teams became essential for meetings and collaboration. Operational data is collected from line-of-business systems, processed inside the analytics platform before Power BI dashboards surface insights to business users.
